Author: Matt Boyle
Message:
train 3: the vault-routing poisoner, eight recovered commits, the hunt family under load, bd-imports --shrink, the append guard, and the ssh gate

Six refute-first-reviewed worker patches, stacked on v3.66.1448.

- row 491 / h326b: test_v3_66_41 leaked app.SITES_FILE into its neighbours;
  closed at the source with a catcher (base pair 6F/13P -> 22 passed).
- row 649 / 649b: eight recovered commits carried onto main, assertions in
  test_db_connection_open_contract.py kept at base strength.
- h1132b: leader-only hunt fixtures opt into a leader-scoped probe (7 of 65
  sites, exactly the named set); production census untouched.
- row 632 / w2-toolchainb: bd-imports accepts --shrink with --update.
- row 511 / w3-appendguard: the suffix guard compares against the pre-append
  original under the lock and now fires.
- row 513 / w3-sshgate: the openssh gate runs its own loopback sshd with
  ForceCommand/PermitUserRC=no asserted.
- integrator: two additive conflicts with train 1 resolved by keeping both
  sides; h326b's anchor exceptions ported into the current registry (9 -> 12);
  import-graph baseline re-frozen; rows 491/649/632/511/513 closed @1449.
Band: 1061 passed, 1 failed (test_row350 descendant-reap, passes alone;
schedule-sensitive, lane adjudicates). Register 599 rows / 57 open. v3.66.1449.

Initial import: BulkDownloader v3.66.805

static project knowledge, imported from the v3.66.805 release zip (2620 tracked
files, 7 guard files byte-identical).

deployed by overlay. Sandbox environments, build output, and runtime state
(BD_HOME, captures, history db) are excluded via .gitignore.

  - gitleaks baselined at 41 accepted findings; a newly injected AWS key and
